orchestration_result.query: Build me a laddered bond portfolio for a 5-year horizon using investment-grade securities only.

bonds.analysis: To create a laddered bond portfolio for a 5-year horizon using only investment-grade securities, we will allocate funds to bonds with maturities ranging from 1 to 5 years. This approach ensures a steady stream of cash flows and reduces interest rate risk by diversifying the portfolio across different maturity dates. Each year, as the bonds mature, the proceeds can be reinvested into new bonds at the longest end of the ladder (5 years in this case). The proposed allocation is 20% to each maturity bucket, which adheres to the constraint that no more than 30% of the portfolio can mature in any single year. This allocation also keeps the portfolio duration well below the 10-year limit and within the warning threshold of 7 years.

orchestration_result.final_recommendation: Allocate 20% to 1-Year Bond (AAA), 20% to 2-Year Bond (AA+), 20% to 3-Year Bond (A), 20% to 4-Year Bond (A-), and 20% to 5-Year Bond (BBB+). This laddered bond portfolio ensures a steady stream of cash flows and reduces interest rate risk while adhering to the investment-grade securities requirement. However, the total allocation to bonds (100%) exceeds the 40% cap for any single asset class. Therefore, the proposed allocation is out of compliance and cannot be implemented as is. A revised allocation is required to meet the portfolio risk bounds.
